You get to be the motor of the warehouse, ensuring millions of flowers reach their destination! 💪🏼 Show your energy and finish your workday early, so you can enjoy free time the rest of the day! 😍 #Baanrader

Read on to find out how your career can bloom! 👇🏼

What we offer
- Earn € 17,98 p/h (incl. holiday allowance)!
- Get the chance to have a contract from RFH!
- Every evening is yours!
- Take home beautiful flowers every three months!
- Pick-up service in Amsterdam!
- Enjoy free ice cream, soup or hot chocolate!

Who you are
As a logistics employee, you meet the following requirements:

- You speak Dutch or English;
- You are minimum 18 years old (due to working hours);
- You are minimum 165CM tall;
- You are available to work from 6:00 AM until 12:00 or 13:00 PM (end time might differ);
- You are a minimum of 2 days a week available;
- You have your own accommodation in the area of Aalsmeer or can get here easily;
- You are available for at least 4 months.

What will you do
Your day is anything but garden-variety! 🌱🌼 You will literally put your pedal to the metal while driving an electric tractor through the warehouse. Using a special headset  🎧, you will hear exactly which orders need to be picked for our customers. You will move flower buckets and plant containers from your cart to the customer’s trolley. Once your car is complete, you will move our floral friends to the right location in the warehouse! 🚀

Where will you work
As a logistics employee, you'll be working at Royal FloraHolland in Aalsmeer. The biggest flower distribution in Europe! ✨ It is a colorful place where you will work with a diverse team of colleagues.
Your work location in Aalsmeer is easily accessible by car or public transport 🚗🚌. Public transport is fully reimbursed! It’s a goo

Are you looking for an active job where hard work is directly rewarded? 💰 At BMN, a warehouse worker building materials earns a solid gross hourly wage of € 15.83 (including allowance)! 🚀 On top of that, extra overtime allowances and free coffee with awesome company parties are included. 🎉 Forget boring office routines, it is time to stay physically active in an amazing team! 🔥 Want to secure this job? Read on quickly and apply today! 🤩

What we offer
- A great salary of € 15.83 (incl. ADV allowance)💰
- Chance of a permanent contract. 🤝
- Working in dayshift 06-17
- support during your onboarding
- Travel allowance 🚗
- Super fun company outings!

Who you are
Ready to hop on the forklift? 💪 Don't have a certificate yet? No worries, you can get certified right here at Tempo-Team! As a warehouse worker, it is important that you meet the following requirements:

- You speak Dutch or English.
- You are available for eight-hour shifts between 06:00 and 17:00 🕖
- You have experience operating a forklift or reach truck 🚜
- You are physically capable of lifting up to 30 kg 💪.
- You can work in Heemstede 😃

What will you do
Every single day brings a brand new and energetic challenge! 🚛 One day you collect heavy materials like wood, roof tiles, and plaster blocks, and the next day you work with small items like screws. This keeps you extremely fit while making time fly by! 🔥 Switching between departments also adds plenty of variety and daily job satisfaction. ⚡ Furthermore, driving the forklift or reach truck keeps the site neat and organized. Great work! 😎

- Collecting materials using paper lists or modern hand scanners
- Preparing orders perfectly for shipment across the Netherlands
- Efficiently loading and unloading goods with the forklift or reach truck
